name: Mitiq
description: Mitiq is an open-source Python toolkit for quantum error mitigation on noisy intermediate-scale quantum computers, developed by Unitary Foundation. It implements techniques including zero-noise extrapolation, probabilistic error cancellation, and Clifford data regression, and integrates with Cirq, Qiskit, pyQuil, and Braket.

sources.title: Mitiq: A software package for error mitigation on noisy quantum computers

news.title: Mitiq v1.1.0 released
news.excerpt: Mitiq v1.1.0 adds an experimental debiasing (symmetrization) technique that runs circuit variants with randomly permuted qubit labels and combines results by averaging or shot-wise plurality vote. Probabilistic Error Amplification now accepts user-supplied OperationRepresentations so hardware-learned noise models can be amplified directly.
